ns2:section.sectionText: This one credit course, designed specifically for mathematics majors, helps you take advantage of opportunities within the department and prepare for careers after your degree. The course features approachable and wide-ranging talks by faculty members, informative graduate student panels, and practical workshops on professional development such as applying to summer programs and internships. Along the way, you’ll get to know many of our talented and committed faculty members and graduate students, in an inclusive and collaborative environment.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Statistics or Mathematics or Math & Computer Science major(s).
